result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.expand_seed_set()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Expand a seed set to a connected module using neighborhood scoring. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L28175-L28233){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.expand_seed_set( seeds, max_size=None, min_score=0.0, ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Starting from seed nodes, greedily adds neighbors that are densely connected to the current module. The score for each candidate is the ratio of its edges to the module over its total degree, favoring nodes tightly linked to the module rather than high-degree hubs. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [seeds]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [list[str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : List of seed node labels. [max_size]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Maximum module size. Defaults to `3 * len(seeds)`. [min_score]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[0.0]{.fl}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Minimum connectivity score for a node to be added. Candidates scoring at or below this threshold are rejected. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [list[int]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Node IDs of the expanded module (includes seeds). ::: ## Raises {.doc-raises} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [ValueError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If any seed node doesn't exist in the graph. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#835ad923 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="Seed1") .add_node(label="Seed2") .add_node(label="Hub") .add_node(label="Tightly_connected") .add_node(label="Loosely_connected") .add_edge("Seed1", "Hub") .add_edge("Seed2", "Hub") .add_edge("Seed1", "Tightly_connected") .add_edge("Seed2", "Tightly_connected") .add_edge("Hub", "Loosely_connected") ) module = graph.expand_seed_set(seeds=["Seed1", "Seed2"], min_score=0.3) [graph.get_label_from_id(nid) for nid in module] ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` ['Seed1', 'Seed2', 'Hub', 'Tightly_connected', 'Loosely_connected'] ``` ::: :::
